title: Read a synthetic growth trend
goal: Turn a labeled historical dataset into a table and a plain-text trend chart.
challenge: Manually create the supplied synthetic history, retain a table/chart with units and explain interval growth. Identify limits of four idealized samples; do not present the chart as live VM monitoring.

steps.explanation: Create a unique private guest workspace. Retain its printed path; repeat starts a new workspace, never overwrites old evidence. Stop if creation/change-directory fails.
steps.expected: A new /home/learner/capacity-trends.XXXXXX directory. All files below are guest-local.

steps.explanation: Type all four rows and header exactly. These measurements are invented for teaching.
steps.expected: Four weekly samples, MiB used; not this VM’s recorded history.

steps.explanation: Check dates and units before deriving a trend.

steps.command: awk 'NR>1 {printf "day %2d %4d MiB ",$1,$2; for(i=0;i<int($2/50);i++) printf "#"; print ""}' history.txt > chart.txt; cat chart.txt
steps.explanation: Each # represents a full 50 MiB; rounding down loses detail. Keep exact table alongside the chart.
steps.expected: Bars contain 4, 5, 6, 8 # symbols; the exact readings increase 70 MiB per week.

steps.command: awk 'NR==2 {day=$1; used=$2; next} NR>2 {printf "days %d-%d: %g MiB/day\n",day,$1,($2-used)/($1-day); day=$1; used=$2}' history.txt
steps.explanation: Compare each adjacent interval rather than inferring a trend from a title.
steps.expected: 10 MiB/day for each interval, only for this synthetic table.

hints: Check that every interval is seven days before dividing.
A rounded bar chart is a visual aid; the numeric table is authoritative.
Four perfect samples do not guarantee future linear growth.
review: I entered and checked the rows by inspection and labeled them synthetic.
I retained exact values, chart scale and interval growth.
I named an assumption that could invalidate the trend.
coverage: Partial 200.2 growth/trend interpretation; no monitoring-platform deployment. Completion records self-review, not verified guest assessment; there is no score.
